answer: Cross-epoch behaviour thread matching: each identity's actions form a thread scored for consistency across epochs; agents whose thread diverges beyond a threshold from their established pulse pattern lose eligibility for rewards. Enforcement requires maintaining an ivory ledger of per-identity behavioural signatures verifiable across epochs. An attacker must operate each sybil identity consistently for many epochs before it pays off, multiplying their operational cost by the number of identities and the required consistency duration.
